subject:

---

**

**  

Dear Technical Sales Team,  

Exide Industries Ltd.,  

We are writing on behalf of **GAIL (India) Limited** to invite your quotation for the supply and installation of a 2 V VRLA Battery Bank as detailed in the tender reference **GEM/2026/B/7357339**. Kindly treat this request as a formal **Request for Quotation (RFQ)** and furnish the required information in accordance with the specifications and commercial terms outlined below.

---

### 1. Project Overview  

| Item | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Procuring Authority** | GAIL (India) Limited |
| **Project Title** | Supply and Installation of 2 V VRLA Battery Bank |
| **Delivery Location** | GAIL Compressor Station, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh |
| **Required Delivery Date** | 15 Oct 2026 |
| **Tender Reference** | GEM/2026/B/7357339 |

---

### 2. Itemized Bill of Quantities (BoQ) & Technical Requirements  

| No. | Item Name | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By |
|-----|-----------|----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------------|
| 1 | 2 V 500 Ah VRLA Battery Cells | 120 | Nos | IS 15549 / IEEE 1188 compliant with inter‑cell copper connectors | GAIL Compressor Station, Visakhapatnam, AP | 15 Oct 2026 |

*All batteries must be brand‑new, factory sealed, and fully tested in accordance with the cited standards.*

---

### 3. Commercial & Delivery Constraints  

| Parameter | Requirement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Delivery Period** | 60 days from receipt of purchase order |
| **Warranty** | 36 months from commissioning date |
| **Payment Terms** | 70 % on supply (upon delivery) and 30 % on successful commissioning |
| **Lead Time** | Please specify in **weeks/days** |
| **GST** | Provide a detailed GST breakdown (CGST, SGST/IGST) in your quotation |
| **Technical Compliance** | Attach a complete technical compliance sheet confirming adherence to IS 15549 and IEEE 1188, including test certificates and material data sheets |

---

### 4. Information Required in Your Quotation  

1. **Unit Price** (INR per unit, exclusive of GST)  
2. **Total Price** (including GST breakdown)  
3. **Lead Time** – expressed in weeks and/or days  
4. **Validity** of the quoted price (minimum 90 days)  
5. **Warranty Details** – scope and claim procedure  
6. **Technical Compliance Sheet** – as per Section 3 above  
7. **Any Additional Charges** (freight, handling, insurance, etc.)  

Please submit your complete quotation in PDF format to **procurement@gail.co.in** no later than **30 Sep 2026**. Late submissions will not be considered.

---

### 5. Contact for Clarifications  

| Name | Designation | Phone | Email |
